entities.name: Abu al-Makarim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu l-Makārim Saʿdullāh ibn Jirjis ibn Masʿūd was a priest of the Coptic Orthodox Church of Alexandria in the thirteenth century. Abu al-Makarim is best known as the author of a famous work entitled History of Churches and Monasteries. This was written around 1200.
